from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,sys
import numpy as np
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'Tools'))
import fit_high_note_saw_wrap_kernels as helper
k,basis=helper.spline(4.)
I=np.array([(k[j+4]-k[j])/4 for j in range(16)])
b=np.r_[1.,2/3,5/12,1/12,np.zeros(12)]
grid=np.linspace(0,4,4001)
nest_error=float(np.max(abs(basis(grid)@b-np.maximum(1-grid,0)**2)))
integral_error=float(np.max(abs(basis.integrate(0,4)-I)))
assert nest_error<1e-12 and integral_error<1e-12

def source(p,inc,neg,pos,limited=False):
 p=np.asarray(p);v=2*p-1
 for i,x in np.ndenumerate(p):
  ks=range(-1,3)if limited else range(int(np.floor(x-4*inc))-1,int(np.ceil(x+4*inc))+2)
  for wrap in ks:
   d=(x-wrap)/inc
   if -4<d<0:v[i]+=basis(-d)@neg
   elif 0<=d<4:v[i]+=basis(d)@pos
 return v-inc*(I@(neg+pos))

def polyblep(p,inc):
 p=np.asarray(p);v=2*p-1
 first=p<inc;last=p>1-inc
 x=p[first]/inc;v[first]-=2*x-x*x-1
 x=(p[last]-1)/inc;v[last]-=x*x+2*x+1
 return v

rng=np.random.default_rng(4715257);n=.2*rng.normal(size=16);p=.3*rng.normal(size=16)
g,w=np.polynomial.legendre.leggauss(4)
rows=[]
for inc in (1/256,.039,.1,.125,.15,.25,.45):
 phases=np.r_[np.linspace(0,1,4096,endpoint=False),.999999999,1e-10]
 limited_error=float(np.max(abs(source(phases,inc,n,p,True)-source(phases,inc,n,p,False))))
 nested=float(np.max(abs(source(phases,inc,-b,b,True)-polyblep(phases,inc))))
 # Split at every possible source polynomial knot, then exact-degree Gaussian
 # quadrature integrates each cubic interval without sampling wrap jumps.
 cuts={0.,1.}
 for wrap in range(-2,4):
  for t in np.unique(k):
   for sign in (-1,1):
    x=wrap+sign*t*inc
    if 0<x<1:cuts.add(x)
 cuts=sorted(cuts);mean=0.
 for lo,hi in zip(cuts,cuts[1:]):
  xx=(hi-lo)*g/2+(hi+lo)/2
  mean+=(hi-lo)/2*np.dot(w,source(xx,inc,n,p,True))
 before=source(np.array([1-1e-11]),inc,n,p,True)[0]
 after=source(np.array([1e-11]),inc,n,p,True)[0]
 # Other overlapping wraps are continuous at phase0; only this wrap jumps.
 jump=-2+p[0]-n[0]
 jump_error=abs(after-before-jump)
 assert limited_error==0 and nested<1e-12 and abs(mean)<1e-12 and jump_error<1e-7
 rows.append(dict(increment=inc,limited_vs_general_periodic_sum_error=limited_error,polyblep_nesting_error=nested,normalized_continuous_mean=float(mean),wrap_jump_error=float(jump_error)))
result=dict(status='passed',helper_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(helper.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),script_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),knots=k.tolist(),basis_count=16,integrals=I.tolist(),exact_polyblep_coefficients=['1','2/3','5/12','1/12']+['0']*12,nesting_error=nest_error,integral_error=integral_error,rows=rows,
 qualification='Continuous-phase integration, not finite sampled-window mean. No source continuity is imposed at natural wrap; general asymmetric jump is checked as a consequence.')
(Path(__file__).parent/'math-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items()if k not in ['knots','integrals','exact_polyblep_coefficients']},indent=2))

"""Independent SciPy-basis comparison to the frozen actual C++ W4Probe."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys
import numpy as np
from scipy.interpolate import BSpline
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT=Path(__file__).parent
BUILD=ROOT/'build-fidelity/saw-w4-engine/build-03'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
manifest=json.loads((BUILD/'manifest.json').read_text())
checks=[]
for name,h in manifest['source_frozen_sha256'].items():
 assert sha(BUILD/'source'/name)==h;checks.append(name)
for name,row in manifest['binaries'].items():
 assert sha(row['path'])==row['sha256'];checks.append(name)
assert sha(BUILD/'builder.py')==manifest['builder']['sha256']
k=np.array([0.]*4+[x for j in range(1,8) for x in [j/2,j/2]]+[4.]*4)
basis=BSpline(k,np.eye(18)[:,:16],3,extrapolate=False)
I=basis.integrate(0,4)
rng=np.random.default_rng(815909)
configurations=[]
for j in range(32):
 c=np.eye(32)[j];configurations.append((f'basis{j}',0.,0.,c[:16],c[16:]))
n=np.r_[1.,2/3,5/12,1/12,np.zeros(12)]
configurations += [('polyblep',1.,0.,-n,n),('asymmetric',1.,.217,.15*rng.normal(size=16),.2*rng.normal(size=16))]
inc_values=[1/256,.039,.1,.125,.15,.25,.45]
points=[]
for inc in inc_values:
 positions=set(rng.random(32).tolist()+[0.,np.nextafter(1.,0.)])
 for knot in np.unique(k):
  for sign in [-1,1]:
   p=(sign*knot*inc)%1
   for q in [np.nextafter(p,-np.inf),p,np.nextafter(p,np.inf)]:
    if 0<=q<1 and (q==0 or q>=1e-300): positions.add(float(q))
 for p in sorted(positions):
  for note,corrected in [(91,1),(60,1),(91,0)]:points.append((p,inc,note,corrected))
text=''.join(f'{p:.17g} {inc:.17g} {note} {corrected}\n' for p,inc,note,corrected in points)
rows=[]
for name,ramp,phase,neg,pos in configurations:
 native=OUT/(name+'.native.txt')
 native.write_text(' '.join(map(str,[1,ramp,phase,*neg,*pos]))+'\n')
 result=subprocess.run([str(BUILD/'W4Probe')],input=text,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True,env=dict(os.environ,SEPTUM_W4_CONFIG=str(native)))
 actual=np.fromstring(result.stdout,sep='\n');expect=[]
 for p,inc,note,corrected in points:
  if not corrected:expect.append(2*p-1);continue
  q=(p+phase)%1 if note==91 and phase!=0 else p
  y=ramp*(2*q-1)-inc*(I@(neg+pos))
  for wrap in range(-3,5):
   d=(q-wrap)/inc
   if -4<d<0:y+=basis(-d)@neg
   elif 0<=d<4:y+=basis(d)@pos
  expect.append(y)
 delta=np.abs(actual-np.array(expect));err=float(delta.max())
 assert err<2e-12,(name,err,points[int(delta.argmax())])
 rows.append(dict(configuration=name,comparisons=len(points),max_absolute_error=err))
# Recompute disabled-native baseline identities from actual files, not receipt booleans.
base=json.loads((ROOT/'build-fidelity/saw-w4-engine/integration-gates-01/baseline-gates.json').read_text())
baselines=[]
for slope,row in base.items():
 h=sha(row['wav']['path']);assert h==row['expected_sha256']==row['wav']['sha256']
 baselines.append(dict(slope=int(slope),wav_sha256=h,exact_identity=True))
receipt=dict(status='passed',script_sha256=sha(__file__),build_manifest_sha256=sha(BUILD/'manifest.json'),builder_sha256=sha(BUILD/'builder.py'),cpp_header_sha256=sha(BUILD/'source/W4Experiment.h'),probe_sha256=sha(BUILD/'W4Probe'),frozen_hash_checks=len(checks)+1,rows=rows,total_comparisons=sum(r['comparisons']for r in rows),max_absolute_error=max(r['max_absolute_error']for r in rows),baselines=baselines,qualification='Independent SciPy BSpline coefficients/integrals and exhaustive periodic reference against compiled De Boor implementation. Tests basis columns, exact/adjacent support/interior boundaries, overlapping supports, note91 phase, other-note identity and corrected=false naive ramp. Not a hardware model fit.')
(OUT/'cpp-source-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in receipt.items()if k!='rows'},indent=2))

"""Recompute frozen backend linearity controls; does not render or optimize."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
import numpy as np
from scipy.io import wavfile
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];OUT=Path(__file__).parent
CONTROL=ROOT/'build-fidelity/saw-w4-engine/controls-01/control-proof.json'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
proof=json.loads(CONTROL.read_text());protocol=json.loads(Path(proof['protocol']['path']).read_text())
checks=[]
def walk(x):
 if isinstance(x,dict):
  if 'path'in x and 'sha256'in x:
   assert sha(x['path'])==x['sha256'],x['path'];checks.append(x['path'])
  for v in x.values():walk(v)
 elif isinstance(x,list):
  for v in x:walk(v)
walk(proof);walk(protocol)
c=np.array(protocol['planted_coefficients']);rows=[]
for row in proof['backend_controls']:
 raw=np.fromfile(row['request']['file']['path'],dtype='<f4').reshape(3528,34).astype(float)
 rate,wav=wavfile.read(row['independent_truth']['path']);assert rate==44100 and wav.dtype==np.float32
 truth=wav[828115:831643,0].astype(float)
 offset=raw[:,0];ramp=raw[:,1];basis=raw[:,2:]-offset[:,None]
 pred=ramp+basis@c
 delta=truth-pred
 computed=dict(phase=row['phase'],offset_peak=float(abs(offset).max()),linearity_relative_rms=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(delta**2)/np.mean(truth**2))),linearity_max_absolute=float(abs(delta).max()))
 design=np.column_stack((basis,np.ones(3528)))
 s=np.linalg.svd(design,compute_uv=False)
 computed.update(coefficient_plus_dc_rank=int(np.linalg.matrix_rank(design)),coefficient_plus_dc_condition=float(s[0]/s[-1]))
 for key in computed:
  assert np.isclose(computed[key],row[key],rtol=1e-8,atol=1e-14),(key,computed[key],row[key])
 for stats in [row['request']['stats'],row['independent_render']['stats'],proof['backend_ready']['prewarm_stats']]:
  assert stats['filter_limit_calls']==stats['output_limit_calls']==0
 assert row['independent_render']['latency_samples']==93
 rows.append(computed)
# The original MIDI contains only one note91 onset; snapshot-phase isolation is valid.
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'Tools'))
from render_midi import parse_smf,replay_events
parsed=parse_smf(Path(protocol['midi']['path']).read_bytes())
events,ignored=replay_events(parsed,channel=1,allow_unsupported=True,tempo_policy='preserve-patch')
selected=[r for r in events if r['kind']=='midi'and bytes.fromhex(r['value'])[1]==91]
assert [r['sample']for r in selected]==[826875,846169]
assert len(events)==248 and len(ignored)==1 and ignored[0]['meta_type']==32
result=dict(status='passed',script_sha256=sha(__file__),control_proof_sha256=sha(CONTROL),frozen_file_checks=len(checks),rows=rows,midi_note91_events=selected,original_events=248,ignored_event='sole FF20 routing meta; raw MIDI hash pinned',qualification='Recomputed actual cached columns against independently full-rendered vectors at known0/.321 phases. No optimizer, no hardware recording, no production edit. These small planted vectors do not establish linearity for arbitrary later large fitted vectors.')
(OUT/'backend-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

"""Verify source-free fitted-control artifacts without rerunning a phase search."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
import numpy as np
from scipy.io import wavfile
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];OUT=Path(__file__).parent;RUN=ROOT/'build-fidelity/saw-w4-engine/phase-controls-01'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
c=json.loads((RUN/'controls.json').read_text());search=json.loads((RUN/'recovery/search.json').read_text());cache=json.loads(Path(c['operator_cache_receipt']).read_text());planted=json.loads((RUN/'planted-source.json').read_text());checks=[]
def chk(p,h):
 assert sha(p)==h,p;checks.append(str(p))
chk(ROOT/'Tools/fit_saw_w4_engine.py',c['identity']['tool_sha256']);chk(ROOT/'Tools/build_saw_w4_experiment.py',c['identity']['builder_sha256']);chk(ROOT/'build-fidelity/saw-w4-engine/build-03/manifest.json',c['identity']['build_manifest_sha256']);chk(c['operator_cache_receipt'],c['operator_cache_receipt_sha256']);chk(c['training_reference'],c['training_reference_sha256'])
for r in cache['records']:
 p=Path(cache['directory'])/r['file'];chk(p,r['sha256'])
 with np.load(p)as d:
  chkbytes=lambda a,h:hashlib.sha256(np.asarray(a,dtype='<f8').tobytes()).hexdigest()==h
  assert chkbytes(d['matrix'],r['matrix_float64_sha256'])and chkbytes(d['offset'],r['offset_float64_sha256'])
 assert r['engine_stats']['filter_limit_calls']==r['engine_stats']['output_limit_calls']==0
best=c['training_best'];assert best==search['best'];valid=[r for r in search['scores']if r['valid']]
assert best['relative_error_power']==min(r['relative_error_power']for r in valid)
assert set(np.arange(256)/256)<=set(r['phase_cycles']for r in search['scores'])
assert len(search['coarse_seed_indices'])<=16
m=best['operator_record'];raw=np.load(Path(cache['directory'])/m['file']);matrix=raw['matrix'];offset=raw['offset'];gain=search['fixed_gain'];coeff=np.array(best['source_coefficients'])
pred=gain*matrix[:,0]+gain*(matrix[:,1:]-offset[:,None])@coeff+best['output_dc']
rate,x=wavfile.read(c['training_reference']);assert rate==44100 and x.dtype==np.float32
target=gain*x[828115:831643,0].astype(float)+planted['output_dc']
assert hashlib.sha256(target.astype('<f8').tobytes()).hexdigest()==search['target_float64_sha256']
error=float(np.mean((target-pred)**2)/np.var(target));assert np.isclose(error,best['relative_error_power'],rtol=1e-7,atol=1e-25)
saved=np.load(RUN/'recovery/best-prediction.npy');maxpred=float(abs(saved-pred).max());assert maxpred<1e-14
chk(RUN/'recovery/best-prediction.npy',search['prediction_sha256'])
transfers=[]
for group in c['canonical_transfers']:
 chk(group['reference'],group['reference_sha256']);chk(group['candidate'],group['candidate_sha256'])
 aa=wavfile.read(group['reference'])[1].astype(float);bb=wavfile.read(group['candidate'])[1].astype(float);assert aa.shape==bb.shape
 for f in [group['reference'],group['candidate']]:
  folder=Path(f).parent;cfg=json.loads((folder/'coefficients.json').read_text());assert cfg['ramp']==1 and cfg['phase_cycles_training_note91']==0
  chk(folder/'patch.syx',c['identity'][f"lp{group['slope']}_patch_sha256"]);chk(folder/'performance.mid',c['identity']['midi_sha256'])
  st=json.loads((folder/'state-stats.json').read_text());assert st['filter_limit_calls']==st['output_limit_calls']==0
 for row in group['rows']:
  a,b=row['samples'];err=float(np.mean((aa[a:b]-bb[a:b])**2)/np.mean(aa[a:b]**2));assert err==row['relative_error_power']and err<1e-8
  transfers.append(dict(slope=group['slope'],support=row['support'],samples=[a,b],relative_error_power=err))
# Recheck full-performance nested polyBLEP identity from bytes.
npath=ROOT/'build-fidelity/saw-w4-engine/nested-full-engine-01/results.json';nested=json.loads(npath.read_text())
for row in nested['rows']:
 for key in ['baseline','nested']:chk(row[key]['path'],row[key]['sha256'])
 assert row['baseline']['sha256']==row['nested']['sha256']
result=dict(status='passed',script_sha256=sha(__file__),control_receipt_sha256=sha(RUN/'controls.json'),fitter_sha256=c['identity']['tool_sha256'],builder_sha256=c['identity']['builder_sha256'],operator_matrices_rechecked=len(cache['records']),file_hash_checks=len(checks),all_coarse_phases_present=True,best_is_minimum_valid_visited=True,selected_phase=best['phase_cycles'],planted_phase=planted['phase_cycles'],phase_error=best['phase_cycles']-planted['phase_cycles'],training_power_error=error,saved_prediction_reconstruction_max_error=maxpred,canonical_transfers=transfers,nested_full_engine_receipt_sha256=sha(npath),nested_both_slopes_byte_identity=True,qualification='Recomputed persisted outputs and identities only; no optimizer or hardware recording opened. Passed planted control establishes this tested recovery/transfer, not unique identification for all targets.')
(OUT/'phase-control-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items()if k!='canonical_transfers'},indent=2))

review.affine_operator: F(ramp)+sum c_j*(F(basis_j)-F(zero)). Every column includes its own complete fixed MIDI prehistory, canonical prior phase, and matching snapshot before note91. Fixed unit-ramp coefficient1.
review.phase_search: 256 fixed coarse phases, at most16 lowest strict cyclic minima including global coarse minimum, bounded refinements; every valid visited minimum retained. Sampled objective can jump at allowed natural wraps; no global optimum claim.
review.normalization: Continuous phase analytic mean only; not a finite sampled-window or commensurate-period DC guarantee.
review.wrap_constraint: No cross-wrap continuity added. Jump=-2+p0-n0; one-sided sample-time slope change=6*(p1-p0+n1-n0). Internal half-sample joins are C1, endpoints +/-4 have zero value and derivative.
review.identifiability: Fixed ramp removes one amplitude ambiguity; finite filtered window can still poorly distinguish coefficient/phase/DC directions or oscillator versus capture response. Held-out actual audio can establish useful improvement without unique architecture proof.
review.required_later_check: Unrestricted fitted coefficients can activate nonlinear knees even when basis columns and planted vectors do not. Independently render the fitted vector at fitted phase, compare to affine prediction after fixed gain/DC, and inspect state/output counters before reporting actual-engine training loss. This does not prevent canonical actual-audio validation.
